scope: Delta review of FIXCXC1 SERVICE guidance and applicable FEE_AND_WAIVER guidance; VF22 direct pixel/source coverage reused only after exact identity comparison.

participant.feeAction: Ask the municipal court clerk what it is before you go.
participant.feeWaiverAction: Ask the same clerk what the court does about a filing fee somebody cannot pay.
participant.serviceAction: Give a copy of the petition to the prosecuting attorney, then complete item 14 with the actual service date and method.
participant.serviceMethodAction: Ask the municipal court clerk how and when to serve the copy.
participant.notarizationAction: Ask the municipal court clerk whether your signature must be witnessed or notarized before you sign.

filing.serviceAction: Give a copy of the petition to the prosecuting attorney, then complete item 14 with the actual service date and method.
filing.feeAction: Ask the municipal court clerk what the filing costs before you go.
filing.feeWaiverAction: Ask the same clerk what the court does about a filing fee somebody cannot pay.
filing.notarizationAction: Ask the municipal court clerk whether your signature must be witnessed or notarized before you sign.
